description: Receive returned units against an issued customer return — the Receiving page's return processing. Each line gives units back in sellable condition (put into stock at the warehouse's receiving location, or receivingLocationId) and units damaged (put into its scrap location, or scrapLocationId). Serial-tracked items need a serial per unit; lots and expiry come from the original shipment. The return receipt is created if needed; once every line is received the return can be credited with create_credit_note. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

damaged.description: Units received damaged, put into the scrap location (>= 0).

damagedSerials.description: Serial numbers of the damaged units, for serial-tracked items (one per unit).

lineId.description: Customer return line id (GUID) from get_return. Either lineId or sku is required.

returned.description: Units received back in sellable condition, put into stock (>= 0).

serials.description: Serial numbers of the returned units, for serial-tracked items (one per unit).

sku.description: Item SKU on the return; must match exactly one line.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

receivingLocationId.description: Optional location id (GUID) or name in the return's warehouse for sellable units; defaults to the warehouse's receiving location.

returnId.description: Customer return id (GUID) or number from list_returns.

scrapLocationId.description: Optional location id (GUID) or name in the return's warehouse for damaged units; defaults to the warehouse's scrap location.

name: receive_customer_return
title: Receive Customer Return
